Reference for the JSON formats the app reads and writes, generated from its data model.

## API

| Schema | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Combatant](/reference/schema/combatant/) | One participant in a combat, and the mutable state that belongs to this fight. |
| [Game](/reference/schema/game/) | The live combat state of a `Campaign`. |
| [Message](/reference/schema/message/) | One entry in a campaign's chat and dice log. |
| [Role](/reference/schema/role/) | Which side a creature is on. |
| [WSEvent](/reference/schema/wsevent/) | One message on the WebSocket connection between the app and its clients. |

## Container

| Schema | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Campaign](/reference/schema/campaign/) | A container for an ongoing game run by the user. |
| [Module](/reference/schema/module/) | A container for a distributable body of game content. |
| [System](/reference/schema/system/) | An installed game system — the ruleset that defines what content looks like. |

## Content

| Schema | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Encounter](/reference/schema/encounter/) | A prepared fight, ready to be loaded into combat. |
| [Group](/reference/schema/group/) | A folder in a container's library tree. |
| [Map](/reference/schema/map/) | A battle map — the playing surface and everything placed on it. |
| [Page](/reference/schema/page/) | A page of written content — the prose half of an adventure. |
| [Reference](/reference/schema/reference/) | A shortcut to other content, placed in a container's library tree. |

## Definitions

| Schema | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [DataTransform](/reference/schema/data-transform/) | A declarative recipe for enriching an entity's JSON context before it is rendered. |
| [EntityDefinition](/reference/schema/entity-definition/) | `EntityDefinition` describes the structure, behavior, and resources associated with a type of game entity |
| [FormDefinition](/reference/schema/form-definition/) | A comprehensive definition structure for building dynamic, configurable forms |
| [TemplateDefinition](/reference/schema/template-definition/) |  |
| [ThemeDefinition](/reference/schema/theme-definition/) | A comprehensive theming system for customizing the visual appearance of native views |
| [ViewDefinition](/reference/schema/view-definition/) | A declarative UI definition structure for building dynamic, data-driven layouts. |

## Entity

| Schema | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Entity](/reference/schema/entity/) | A flexible, game-agnostic entity representation for tabletop RPG content. |
| [Modifier](/reference/schema/modifier/) | A rule modifier that changes an entity attribute. |
| [StatusEffect](/reference/schema/status-effect/) | A condition or ongoing effect on a `Combatant`. |
| [Table](/reference/schema/table/) | A random table that can be rolled on. |

## Map

| Schema | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [AreaEffect](/reference/schema/area-effect/) | A marked-out area on a `Map` — a spell template or zone. |
| [Asset](/reference/schema/asset/) | A reusable piece of artwork placed on a `Map`. |
| [Aura](/reference/schema/aura/) | A radial area drawn around a `Token`, moving with it. |
| [Light](/reference/schema/light/) | A light source on a `Map`. |
| [Marker](/reference/schema/marker/) | A point of interest pinned to a `Map`. |
| [Measurement](/reference/schema/measurement/) | A distance measurement drawn on a `Map`. |
| [Tile](/reference/schema/tile/) | A piece of scenery placed on a `Map`. |
| [Token](/reference/schema/token/) | A creature placed on a `Map`. |
| [Vision](/reference/schema/vision/) | What a `Token` can see, and what it carries to see by. |

| Schema | Description |
